coordinate_system: (x,y), top-left pixel center; all source images loaded at 1200 x 900
point_selection: Manually seeded landmark pairs, refined by local normalized patch correlation within 26 (Gateway) or 30 (Frontview) pixels. A fixed-seed reprojection-consistency filter removes mismatches/parallax points; retained pairs are fitted by least squares. No automatic interest-point detection is used.
procedure: Gateway uses original computH for planar homographies. Frontview uses cylindrical projection at f=900 px followed by adjacent 2D similarity fits. Both compose transforms into the middle view, inverse-sample originals once, match overlap exposure with a robust RGB affine fit, and composite with sigma=6 frequency bands, a sigma=32 soft mask, and accumulated validity masks.
